chars.COUSIN: COUSIN: a Moroccan young woman of about 24 with long dark wavy hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and silver hoop earrings
chars.BROTHER: BROTHER: a Moroccan young man of 21 with short black hair and light stubble, wearing an olive-green bomber jacket over a plain white t-shirt
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a Moroccan young woman of 19 with long straight dark hair in a high ponytail, wearing an oversized lilac sweatshirt and grey joggers
